scripts.build:check: build_dir=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$build_dir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM && vite build --outDir "$build_dir/dashboard" && vite build --config vite.chat-app.config.js --outDir "$build_dir/chat" && test -s "$build_dir/dashboard/.vite/manifest.json" && test -s "$build_dir/chat/chat-app.js"
scripts.quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build:check && .venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && .venv/bin/ruff check . && .venv/bin/ruff format --check app.py infrastructure/startup_requirements.py tests/test_startup_requirements.py tests/test_startup_scripts.py
